item.title: The Campaigns Against Russell Brand and JD Vance, with Bret Weinstein, Plus Alarming Jennifer Lawrence and Mariah Carey Looks, with Kirsten Fleming | Ep. 1445 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly is joined by Bret Weinstein, co-host of The DarkHorse Podcast, to discuss the UK government’s shocking ongoing efforts to silence and censor Russell Brand, Google’s pushback against the government’s attempt to bully them, the broader implications for free speech and online censorship, why the campaign against Brand is much bigger than one person, the political battle over Vice President JD Vance spilling out into the public now, the competing factions within the Republican Party, how disagreements over the Iran War could shape the GOP’s future, concerns about AI replacing human workers, distressing recent outages and disruptions across the country, whether these events could be conditioning Americans for an effort to implement limitations on our freedoms, the lie of "abundance," the growing concerns surrounding AI, why current efforts to address the AI crisis are missing the real problem, what meaningful solutions could look like, and more. Then Kirsten Fleming, features columnist at the New York Post, joins to discuss Prince Harry’s absurd comments about potentially returning to military service to fight alongside Ukraine against Russia, his criticism of President Trump, actress Jennifer Lawrence’s completely new face, how beautiful and unique looking she was before, the rise of plastic surgery in our culture, Mariah Carey’s concerning appearance in her latest concert performance, her appearing to be alarmingly stiff while performing, and more.
